semantic_groups.rationale: Represents the normal ADR-0017 authority mode without allowing current-state cases to dominate calibration.
semantic_groups.protected_failure_mode: Threshold rejects trustworthy current evidence or accepts weak current evidence.

semantic_groups.rationale: Exercises independently evaluated PRIMARY and COMPARISON evidence.
semantic_groups.protected_failure_mode: One comparison side is lost or weak evidence on one side is accepted.

semantic_groups.rationale: Protects date-scoped evidence across authority transitions.
semantic_groups.protected_failure_mode: A threshold masks loss of historically authoritative evidence.

semantic_groups.rationale: Exercises ADR-0022 historical-reference resolution independently from date-scoped retrieval.
semantic_groups.protected_failure_mode: The intended prior authority is rejected or an unintended historical version is accepted.

semantic_groups.rationale: Aggregates the temporal authority traps that must not regress while selecting a threshold.
semantic_groups.protected_failure_mode: Scheduled, withdrawn, never-authoritative or resurrected evidence is accepted incorrectly.

semantic_groups.rationale: Protects the server-side applicability boundary across universal, regional and site scopes.
semantic_groups.protected_failure_mode: Inapplicable evidence is accepted or applicable evidence is removed by threshold selection.

semantic_groups.rationale: Ensures resolved organisational aliases continue to produce the correct applicability scope.
semantic_groups.protected_failure_mode: A valid alias loses evidence or resolves into an inapplicable scope.

semantic_groups.rationale: Measures completeness over distinct EvidenceUnits rather than repeated chunk credit.
semantic_groups.protected_failure_mode: Thresholding preserves a partial answer while discarding a required EvidenceUnit.

semantic_groups.rationale: Requires complete evidence that no single document can supply.
semantic_groups.protected_failure_mode: Thresholding removes one document and leaves a plausible but incomplete evidence set.

semantic_groups.rationale: Prevents aggregate recall gains from masking acceptance of retrieval-manipulating content.
semantic_groups.protected_failure_mode: Keyword-stuffed, conflicting or deceptively similar evidence clears the threshold.

semantic_groups.rationale: Ensures threshold selection cannot trade away truthful abstention for aggregate recall.
semantic_groups.protected_failure_mode: The system produces evidence where the benchmark requires a controlled non-evidence outcome.

threshold_sensitive_outcomes.rationale: Covers reranked candidates that do not meet the evidence threshold.
Covers threshold loss on either independently evaluated comparison side.

domain_requirements.rationale: Every high-risk care domain must independently contribute threshold evidence.
Physical safety procedures require meaningful combined representation.
Privacy and complaint-handling duties must not disappear behind operational averages.
Routine workforce and operational knowledge must remain represented without dominating the population.

exclusion_rules: Exclude cases or semantic clusters assigned to engineering/tuning.
Exclude cases or semantic clusters assigned to sealed held-out acceptance.
Exclude cases selected because observed provider or reranker scores favour a threshold.
Exclude evidence-seeking cases without reviewed source-anchored EvidenceUnits.
Exclude controlled-rejection cases without an exact expected outcome.
Exclude cases depending on an unimplemented product capability.
Exclude cases with unresolved governance or applicability facts.
Exclude ground truth coupled to chunk, extracted-element or vector identities.
Exclude changed cases unless the immutable benchmark version advances.
